# ShaadiTemplate

> Free online maker for Indian wedding invitation cards. Pick a design for Save the Date, Ring Ceremony, Haldi, Mehendi, Sangeet, the wedding or the reception, fill in the families' names in English, Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati, Punjabi or Tamil (phonetic typing, no Indian keyboard needed), and download a 1080x1920 image for WhatsApp or a 5x7 inch print-ready PDF. No login; drafts stay in the visitor's browser. Made in Surat, India.

## Designs

- [Designs by ceremony and language](https://shaaditemplate.com/templates/): every design with a preview
- [Wedding invitation cards](https://shaaditemplate.com/templates/wedding-invitations.html): kankotri, shaadi card, lagna patrika, Anand Karaj, Christian and more
- [Gujarati invitations](https://shaaditemplate.com/templates/gujarati-invitations.html), [Hindi](https://shaaditemplate.com/templates/hindi-invitations.html), [Marathi](https://shaaditemplate.com/templates/marathi-invitations.html), [Punjabi](https://shaaditemplate.com/templates/punjabi-invitations.html), [Tamil](https://shaaditemplate.com/templates/tamil-invitations.html)
